subject: Re: Fee rebalancing + SOW appendix — coordination for legal redlines
messages:
From: Elena Moroz <elena@stratalytics.io>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: productops@stratalytics.io, legal@stratalytics.io
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: rebalance fee ladder + SOW appendix edits

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed internally, Stratalytics is trying to simplify our procurement for Q1 and would like to adjust the proposed fee ladder so we can move more capacity into a predictable monthly band with a smaller per-token overage. That will help our forecasting and finance approvals.

Two asks to move forward:
- Can Redwood provide a redline of the SOW appendix that moves 60% of the burst pool into the committed band and updates the implementation milestone dates?
- Can you confirm commercial impact as a single table (current vs proposed monthly committed nodes + overage rate)?

I attached our internal preferred spreadsheet to show the target bands. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Attachment: fee_ladder_request_stratalytics.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Elena Moroz
Head of Procurement, Stratalytics
elena@stratalytics.io
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Elena Moroz <elena@stratalytics.io>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebalance fee ladder + SOW appendix edits

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the spreadsheet. We can do the SOW appendix redline and provide a one-page commercial delta table by EOD Monday (Dec 7). I've looped in Connor (sales ops) and Laura (legal ops) to scope the change order path and get an estimate for the timeline to sign.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Redwood prepares a redline SOW appendix (tracked changes) showing the capacity reallocation and revised milestone dates.
2) Sales ops produces a consolidated fee-comparison table (current vs proposed).
3) Legal runs a light review and confirms whether a full MSA amendment or a change order is sufficient.

Connor, Laura — can you confirm we can turn this in 5 business days and flag any gating legal language (e.g., termination/fallback on committed nodes, pro rata billing period, acceptance criteria changes)?

Happy to hop on a short call with your team Thurs or Fri if that speeds things up.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, Elena Moroz <elena@stratalytics.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebalance fee ladder + SOW appendix edits

Elena / Ava —

We reviewed the numbers and can produce the delta table. Initial check: moving ~60% of burst into committed reduces the effective per-token price by ~18% at your current usage profile, but it also shortens the overage window which will change how credits are applied for the first 30 days after cutover.

I'll generate:
- Fee comparison (monthly committed nodes, monthly charge, overage rate)
- Billing flow note (proration, invoice timing, acceptance checkpoint)

Laura — if legal is good with a change order that references Exhibit A adjustments, call out any specific language you want included (e.g., auto-fallback to original band if average utilization drops below 40% in a trailing 60-day window).

Connor
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, Elena Moroz <elena@stratalytics.io>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebalance fee ladder + SOW appendix edits

Elena / Team —

Attached is our formal redline: STRAT_SOW_v3_redline.docx. High-level legal guidance:
- We recommend a Change Order that Amends Exhibit A and the Fee Schedule only (keeps the master MSA untouched). That will keep signatures light and limit risk.
- Include a short "Utilization Guardrail" clause: if trailing 60-day average utilization falls below 40% of the committed band, Redwood may revert to the prior fee band after a 30-day notice period. This protects capacity economics.
- Pro rata invoicing should be explicit for the first billing cycle post-change; include a 7-day invoice dispute window.

Two items probably need executive sign-off on your side: the proposed fallback and the shortened acceptance window for milestone #2 (we moved it earlier by 10 business days).

Attachment: STRAT_SOW_v3_redline.docx (docx)

Happy to review the final copy after you confirm acceptance of the guardrail language.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Elena Moroz <elena@stratalytics.io>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, legal@stratalytics.io
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebalance fee ladder + SOW appendix edits

Thanks, Laura — and thanks team.

Stratalytics reviews the redline and the fallback clause frankly looks reasonable; Procurement needs a single clarifying tweak: can we add a one-time right to request a "soft review" within the first 90 days to discuss utilization anomalies before a formal reversion notice? Not intended to block the fallback, just to enable a reconciliation conversation.

If Redwood accepts that language, we can route the change order for signatures next week and target an effective date of Jan 1. Elena (legal@stratalytics.io) will prepare internal approvals Friday.

Attachment: stratalytics_internal_approval_sheet.pdf (pdf)

Elena
Head of Procurement, Stratalytics
